from pathlib import Path

repo = Path("/Users/steventran/jobpipe")
wrapper = repo / "jobpipe.py"
wrapper.write_text(
    '#!/usr/bin/env python3\n'
    '"""jobpipe command-line entry point."""\n\n'
    'from jobctl import main\n\n'
    'if __name__ == "__main__":\n'
    '    raise SystemExit(main())\n',
    encoding="utf-8",
)
wrapper.chmod(0o755)

readme = repo / "README.md"
text = readme.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
text = text.replace("# Jobops\n", "# jobpipe\n", 1)
text = text.replace(
    "> A Codex-native job application operating system for lazy job seekers: deterministic ATS automation that balances speed and application quality while keeping JavaScript-heavy browser work—and token use—low.",
    "> A local job-search pipeline that discovers, prioritizes, prepares, applies, verifies, and tracks jobs with deterministic ATS automation."
)
text = text.replace(".venv/bin/python jobctl.py", ".venv/bin/python jobpipe.py")
readme.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")

notice = repo / "JOBPIPE.md"
notice.write_text(
    "# jobpipe\n\n"
    "jobpipe builds on the MIT-licensed Jobops codebase while focusing the product on continuous job discovery and orchestration.\n\n"
    "The inherited ATS execution engine remains intentionally conservative: verified candidate facts, deterministic adapters where possible, duplicate-submit protection, and human handoff for CAPTCHA, MFA, account locks, and unknown sensitive answers.\n\n"
    "## Command surface\n\n"
    "- `python jobpipe.py init`\n"
    "- `python jobpipe.py policy`\n"
    "- `python jobpipe.py queue --list`\n"
    "- `python jobpipe.py status`\n"
    "- `python jobpipe.py apply-csv --limit 1`\n\n"
    "Discovery and continuous orchestration are the primary jobpipe extension layer.\n",
    encoding="utf-8",
)

print("created jobpipe.py")
print("updated README.md")
print("created JOBPIPE.md")
